verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents its own bulk user imports and exports, so it can move many user records at once (auth0-docs-11, auth0-docs-46, auth0-docs-57, auth0-docs-66). That bulk capability is scoped to user migration and data movement. The MCP server and CLI evidence covers multi-step tenant management and task automation, but nothing explicitly about batch operations. missing for 10: bulk update/delete across other object types (roles, apps, org members), documented bulk operations exposed through the MCP server or CLI agent mode for AI-native workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk job behavior and limits.
